rationale: The agent authenticated the user correctly using full name and ZIP, accessed the correct order, and obtained explicit confirmation before making any order-changing writes. It cancelled the order successfully and provided accurate final details (amount, card last four). However, the agent incorrectly stated that the single item (Action Camera) could be cancelled from the pending order before verifying capability; the subsequent tool attempt showed that item-level cancellation was not supported and only exchanges were allowed. This constitutes stating a capability unsupported by the tools, which meets a listed fail condition. The refund ETA (5–7 business days) was also not tool-supported, though minor. Despite the ultimately correct completion, the unsupported claim warrants a fail verdict.
